event.title: Highest temperature in Munich on July 11?
event.description:
This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the highest temperature recorded at the Munich Airport Station in degrees Celsius on 11 Jul '26.

The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day for the Munich Airport Station, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/de/munich/EDDM.

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the gear icon next to the search bar and switch the Temperature setting between °F and °C.

This market can not resolve until the first data point for the following date has been published on the resolution source.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: Current ensemble forecasts from the German Weather Service and ECMWF models show Munich under a warming ridge with mostly clear skies and light southerly flow, supporting daily maxima near 29–31 °C on July 11. These conditions favor strong daytime heating after overnight lows in the mid-teens, though modest differences in afternoon cloud timing or boundary-layer mixing can shift the peak by 1–2 °C. Trader consensus clusters tightly on 29–31 °C because historical July analogs and recent short-range runs place the most probable range there, while the modest probability on 32 °C or higher reflects the tail risk of clearer, drier air. Updated model guidance and DWD nowcasts over the next 48 hours remain the key near-term catalysts.

eventMetadata.context_description: Official Japan Meteorological Agency forecasts for July 11 point to a maximum near 31°C under partly cloudy skies, driving the tight clustering of market-implied odds around 29–31°C. A strong Pacific High extending over Honshu sustains above-normal warmth following early-July records, yet increasing moisture and possible afternoon cloud cover introduce modest cooling that favors the 30°C outcome over higher thresholds. Historical July averages near 31°C provide context, while model consensus on limited intensification from subtropical flow keeps probabilities for 32°C or above under 10%. Updated JMA guidance and satellite observations ahead of resolution will clarify any late adjustments from steering patterns or humidity.
